alt: 傍晚的樹枝與灌木只是普通植物，緊張的人卻把它們的影子都看成躲藏的人，越看越害怕。
scene_prompt: 草木皆兵 means nervous suspicion makes harmless surroundings seem full of enemies. Modern park path at early dusk, still safe and gently lit. A nervous adult walker shrinks back from ordinary bushes and tree branches, holding a small flashlight. The real plants are clearly visible and harmless; a faint translucent pencil imagination overlay gives their cast shadows human-like hiding silhouettes, showing fear is a mistaken interpretation. A calm companion nearby points reassuringly at a plainly visible leafy branch. No real attackers, no weapons, no horror monster, no actual military. Contrast normal plants with imagined threatening shapes, suitable for children.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Scene:
